name: wind-waker-majora-themes
displayName: Wind Waker × Majora — Zelda Color Themes
description: Two cohesive color themes for VS Code and Positron inspired by The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (Wind Waker Light — warm parchment, Great Sea turquoise, nautical) and Majora's Mask (Majora's Mask Dark — cosmic violet, neon, eerie). Includes a toggle command to switch between them.
